info.title: Paya API
info.description: Paya - Raast P2M payment assurance platform (academic prototype; synthetic data; no real money).

get.description: Open tills near the customer (demo convenience when a camera scan is not possible).
Week 9 reconciliation stack: technical, operational, financial and exception-management checks.
Live governance metrics for the agent (monitoring, not the offline evaluation).

post.description: Begin opening a wallet. Returns a 30-minute token that can only complete this application.
Issue a SYNTHETIC specimen identity (and its signed code) so no real ID card is ever photographed.
Re-deliver the latest settled event to every consumer: proves duplicate-safe consumption.
